summary: Springview Holdings Ltd filed a routine 6-K containing its interim financial report for the period ended June 30, 2026, covering XBRL-tagged balance sheet, income statement, segment, and related-party disclosures. No transactional event is disclosed; the filing reflects ordinary periodic reporting by a foreign private issuer (equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q). Related-party references include entities tied to the chairman and payments to GGL affiliates for interior design services, but no price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for future disclosures on related-party dealings and the company's disclosed private placement of Class A ordinary shares.
